certificate_expiry.measurement: Same signed certificate verified twice against the pinned public key: within TTL it is accepted; past expires_at verification reports expired with verdict_expired_recertification_required and licenses nothing.

fleet_false_lockout_accounting.measurement: Declared decision window {k_max, delta} with per-decision e-BH threshold_used and budget accounting recorded for executed and gated_out proposals.

priced_inspection.measurement: Certificate quotes the inspection alternative in native units (expected rounds to gate crossing); dollar figures appear only with an explicit dollars_source.

refusal_as_output.measurement: Over-budget proposal returned a structured refusal verdict with a machine reason code rather than an exception, timeout, or silent allow.
